batch: 4 (chs 18-20, the potter, the broken flask, the confessions' peak)

units.characteristics: the reworkable clay; God's dealing conditional on turning; the defiant self-will
units.gist: GEM - the potter's house: 'like the CLAY in the potter's hand, so are you in my hand'; the vessel spoiled is REWORKED; God's word is CONDITIONAL - 'if that nation TURNS from its evil, I will RELENT... if it does evil, I will relent of the good'; the summons 'RETURN, every one from his evil way'; but the people: 'THAT IS IN VAIN! We will follow OUR OWN PLANS, every one act according to the STUBBORNNESS of his evil heart'

units.characteristics: the fired flask broken past mending; the point of no return; the stiffened neck
units.gist: GEM (the dark counterpart to the reworkable clay) - the potter's earthenware FLASK broken in the valley: 'so will I break this people and this city, as one breaks a potter's vessel, SO THAT IT CAN NEVER BE MENDED'; the child-sacrifice 'which did not come into my mind'; 'because they have STIFFENED THEIR NECK, refusing to hear my words' - the fired, hardened vessel that can no longer be re-formed, unlike the soft clay

units.characteristics: overpowered by God; the word a fire that cannot be held in; the oscillation of praise and despair
units.gist: THE CONFESSIONS' PEAK - Pashhur beats Jeremiah, stocks; 'O LORD, YOU HAVE DECEIVED ME, and I was deceived; you are STRONGER THAN I, and you have PREVAILED; I have become a LAUGHINGSTOCK'; 'if I say, I will not speak in his name, there is in my heart a BURNING FIRE SHUT UP IN MY BONES, and I am weary with holding it in, AND I CANNOT'; 'the LORD is with me as a DREAD WARRIOR'; 'SING to the LORD!'; then the plunge - 'CURSED BE THE DAY on which I was born' - faith and despair held raw and unresolved
